top_signals.title: Gold Pares Losses as Fed’s Williams Signals 2027 End to Hikes
top_signals.summary: Gold pared losses after Federal Reserve Bank of New York President John Williams said he still sees one more interest-rate hike as appropriate this year, but doesn’t expect further tightening in 2027.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
